method: Judgment scores 1-5 on likelihood, harm, hidden-ness, recognition; order by total then harm. Not statistics.

top10.name: The Debt Prison
top10.why_it_ranks: The math nobody explains. Recoupment and cross-collateralization can leave a balance that never clears, and the person owing it often cannot reproduce the numbers.
top10.hook: You're a frontwoman, twenty-six years old, standing in an apartment you could not have imagined two years ago. The floors are bare wood.

spot_it.cue: Ask: "Can I reproduce what I owe, from which income, and when it could clear?" Concern rises if: "No, and the answer is always 'it's complicated.'"
Ask: "Does my balance follow me from this record to the next?" Concern rises if: "Yes, and I was told it was a technicality."

chain_breakers: Before signing, have an independent entertainment attorney read the schedule and the cross-collateralization clause, and ask what an unrecouped balance would mean in practice.
Ask for a plain-language summary of each recoupable category and a worked example of when the balance could clear.
safer_language: Could you send me an itemized recoupment statement with each category listed?
I'd like a worked example showing when the balance could clear under the current schedule.

top10.name: The Phantom Equity
top10.why_it_ranks: A promised stake that is never papered. It is invisible until the money arrives, and by then the only record is a conversation.
top10.hook: You're a graphic and merch designer, twenty-nine, and for the last fourteen months you have been the visual identity of a small indie imprint. Every cover, every shirt, every tour poster, the little hand-cut logo in the corner of the release pages: yours.

spot_it.cue: Ask: "Can we put what I get, what I give, and when it ends on one page this month?" Concern rises if: the answer is a reason to wait, or an explanation instead of a page.
Ask: "What exact event releases the paperwork, and by what date must it happen?" Concern rises if: the event has already changed once and no date is offered.

chain_breakers: Ask for a one-page term sheet now. Rough is enough: a share, a trigger date, what happens on departure. The point is a thing you can show an adviser.
Price the work openly. Invoice at your normal rate with the discount shown as a line, so the record states what you gave.
safer_language: Before I start the spring run, can we put the founding-contributor terms on one page, even roughly?
What exact event triggers the paperwork, and by what date should it happen?

top10.name: The Erased Contributor
top10.why_it_ranks: Credit disappears in the room, and the contributor is talked over. Almost every songwriter or session player knows someone it happened to.
top10.hook: You're a lyric adaptation writer, thirty-three, and your craft is unusual: you take a pop hit written in one language and rebuild it for another market so that it scans, rhymes, and still means something to someone who never heard the original. It is not translation.

spot_it.cue: Ask: "Does the earliest dated file show my contribution before it appeared under another name?" Concern rises if: the dated file exists and nobody wants to look at it.
Ask: "At which step in the chain did my name disappear, and who made that change?" Concern rises if: no one can say, and each person points at the next.

chain_breakers: Write the same-day summary. After a meeting, send a short note: "Following up on my suggestion to keep the pun in verse two, which I drafted on the fourth." Dated, polite, copied to the group.
Keep dated drafts and version history. The file is your quietest witness.
safer_language: I'd like to finish my point on the second verse, and then I'm happy to hear yours.
Following up on today: I drafted the pun in verse two on the fourth. The file is attached.

top10.name: The Normalization Engine
top10.why_it_ranks: 'That's standard.' The most likely line anyone hears, and the gateway that makes bigger terms feel normal.
top10.hook: You're a fifty-two-year-old bus driver, and you have kept a paper hours log since before the company gave you a tablet. You like paper.

spot_it.cue: Ask: "If someone showed me the first page of this run, would I call today the same job?" Concern rises if: "No, but nobody can say when it changed."
Ask: "When was the last time a one-time favor was reversed?" Concern rises if: "Never, and it now has a column on the form."

chain_breakers: Save the first page. Photograph the original schedule and first log pages and store them where only you control them. A baseline outside the system cannot be shifted.
Do the cumulative arithmetic. Once a month, one line: original terms, current practice, difference.
safer_language: Before I confirm, can you send the schedule in writing so I can compare it to my log?
I'm glad to help tonight. Can we write down that it's for tonight only, and when the rest gets made up?
top10.safety_note: This script touches on driver fatigue, which is a physical-danger issue for the driver, passengers and everyone on the road. If you are too tired to drive safely, stopping is the right call, and no schedule or reputation concern outranks it. If anyone is in immediate danger, contact local emergency services. Questions about hours limits and rest rules are jurisdiction-specific [LEGAL CLAIM — JURISDICTION-SPECIFIC] and belong with a union or guild representative, a labor or transport authority, or an employment attorney, not with the people who benefit from the schedule. Do not confront anyone while exhausted or on the road.

top10.name: The Room
top10.why_it_ranks: Highest personal-safety stakes: closed late-night rooms. It ranks high for severity, and it is the one entry here that leads with safety, not strategy.
top10.hook: You're a rehearsal pianist, twenty-three, the kind who gets called when a session needs someone fast, quiet and on time. You have played in a dozen studios.

spot_it.cue: Ask: "Can I leave this room, and the building, whenever I choose, without asking?" Concern rises if: the door is locked, the key is not mine, or leaving needs permission.
Ask: "Do I have a way to reach someone and a person who knows where I am?" Concern rises if: my phone is held and no one expects a message from me.

chain_breakers: Tell a trusted person before you go. Share the address and the time you expect to leave, and agree on a check-in message.
Keep your phone with you where you can. If a locker is required for unreleased material, ask for an alternative, or decline to go.
safer_language: Thanks for having me. I have a hard stop at eleven, so I'll head out soon.
I'd rather keep my phone with me. If that's not possible, I'll listen another time.
top10.safety_note: This material describes a climate of sexual risk in a closed room. If you are in a room now and feel unsafe, your priority is getting to safety, not winning an argument or protecting an opportunity. Contact emergency services or local police if you are in danger, or a trusted person who can come to you or call you. Do not confront anyone. If something has happened to you, specialist sexual-assault and crisis support services exist and can talk without any obligation to report. Nothing here suggests that you are at fault for what another person does, or for the way your body responded to fear.

top10.name: The Halo Shield
top10.why_it_ranks: A beloved figure's public goodness is used to shield them, so reports are disbelieved. Rare to meet, very hard to act on when you do.
top10.hook: You're a volunteer coordinator, thirty-five, and for six years you have run the people side of the benefit concert for a star everyone loves. You do it for expenses and a lanyard.

spot_it.cue: Ask: "When I asked about a figure, did I get a document, or a reminder of how good the person is?" Concern rises if: the answer is consistently the reminder.

Ask: "Can the statement's claim be checked against the actual table, date or approval it relies on?" Concern rises if: the report is cited as proof but nobody will walk through the column you asked about.

chain_breakers: Separate the two truths out loud. "The giving is real, and I still need the distributed figure explained."
Ask in writing, once, briefly. A dated email stating the question, the document it concerns and when you would like a reply. Keep the reply, or the silence.
safer_language: I believe the giving is real. I'd still like the distributed figure explained in writing.
Can you point me to the reconciliation for the column in the program, so I can understand it?

top10.name: The Economics Obfuscation Layer
top10.why_it_ranks: Costs and downside terms spread across affiliated entities and waterfalls so nobody can see the whole picture.
top10.hook: You're a dream-pop artist, twenty-eight, with a little over a million monthly listeners, and you have just been told by an accountant you hired yourself that you made less last year than the tour bus driver on your last run. You came to this office because something did not add up in a way you could feel but not name.

spot_it.cue: Ask: "Can someone show me income, every deduction and my net on one page?" Concern rises if: no one can, or the answer is a portal that shows only one entity.
Ask: "Which of these companies are related, and who owns each?" Concern rises if: the answer is vague, or you learn of the link from the paperwork itself.

chain_breakers: Ask for a consolidated statement. One page covering all entities and fees for the period, in plain language. A clear answer is reassuring; a refusal is information.
Ask for a written payout order before the next signing: what is recouped first, what is cross-collateralized, what is reserved.
safer_language: Before I sign, could you send everything related to this agreement, from every entity, together?
Could you prepare a single page showing income, all deductions and my net for the last four quarters?

top10.name: The NDA Silencer
top10.why_it_ranks: The one no one sees: payment traded for silence means the next person never gets warned. It protects every other pattern here.
top10.hook: You're a session backing vocalist, thirty-eight, and you have spent three years standing a few steps behind the light. Two world tours, three albums, a hundred and some hotel rooms that blur together.

spot_it.cue: Ask: "Does 'confidential information' cover what I saw and how people were treated, or only unreleased work and business terms?" Concern rises if: it covers behavior, relationships and conditions.
Ask: "Does the agreement say I can still speak to authorities, doctors, therapists and my own lawyer?" Concern rises if: it says nothing, or says the opposite.

chain_breakers: Do not sign on the first day. Ask in writing for more time to review.
Get independent advice. An entertainment or employment attorney with no tie to the artist, label or management, or a union or guild representative, before you respond.
safer_language: I'd like more time to review this with my own lawyer before I respond.
Could you confirm in writing what the confidentiality clause does not prevent me from saying, and to whom?
top10.safety_note: This script touches on witnessed misconduct on tour, which can include harassment, substance use and exploitation of crew. If anyone is in immediate danger, contact emergency services. If you witnessed or experienced sexual harassment or assault, a survivor-support line or victim-services advocate can help you at your own pace, and an independent attorney can explain what a confidentiality term does and does not stop you from saying to authorities, counselors and doctors, which varies by place [LEGAL CLAIM — JURISDICTION-SPECIFIC]. Substance, relapse and mental-health concerns belong with medical and crisis professionals. If a minor may be at risk, contact the local child-protection authority. This material does not advise confronting anyone, and it is not legal, clinical or safety advice.

top10.name: The Soft Sell
top10.why_it_ranks: Small recurring fees and 'free' starts that quietly continue. Low stakes each time, very wide reach among independent artists.
top10.hook: You're a wedding-band violinist, thirty-four, and you have a rule about money: never be the person who makes it awkward. You play five or six weddings a month with a band, and on the side you book your own smaller gigs: ceremonies, drinks receptions, the occasional corporate dinner where you play behind a pillar.

spot_it.cue: Ask: "What will I have paid by the end of the first year, with every add-on?" Concern rises if: the page cannot show one clear number before you click.
Ask: "Can I end this in as few steps as it took to start it?" Concern rises if: cancelling needs more screens, a call or a "Are you sure?" loop.

chain_breakers: Read the plan screen before the card screen, and screenshot it. If the total is not visible, that is information.
Untick every pre-selected extra and make each one earn its place separately.
safer_language: Before I sign up, can you tell me the total I'll be charged after the trial?
I'd like to cancel before the trial ends. Please confirm in writing that no charge will follow.

top10.name: The Memory Hole
top10.why_it_ranks: Versions, emails and records go missing, so the original promise cannot be proven. The fix is cheap and early: keep your own copies.
top10.hook: You're a tour accountant, forty years old, and you are very good at the dullest and most important part of live music: you remember what was paid. Night after night, in a windowless office behind a venue, you reconcile the box office report, the merchandise count and the guarantee against the settlement sheet, and you sign your initials where the promoter signs theirs.

spot_it.cue: Ask: "Where is the later version that replaced this one, and who signed it?" Concern rises if: no document can be shown.
Ask: "Will the purge pause for material that is currently questioned?" Concern rises if: it will not, or nobody can say.

chain_breakers: Raise the retention question in writing, immediately. "A figure from the March shows is in question. Please confirm in writing that the related settlement files will be retained until it is resolved."
Hold only what you are authorized to hold. Keep your own working papers, notes and sent items, lawfully. Do not copy, move or open files you are not permitted to access.
safer_language: A figure from those shows is in question. Please confirm in writing that the related files will be retained.
Could you send me the signed final that replaced the deal memo?
